name: code
description: Tools that act on a codebase — a senior code-reviewer agent, a feedback-loop-first diagnosing-bugs skill, and two paired refactor commands split by what they change: /refactor-code for implementations (driven by the code-smells catalog) and /refactor-modules for interfaces and seams (driven by the codebase-design vocabulary), each auditing into a visual Artifact report before touching anything.
